title: On Listening to the same bell for years
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：listen　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 listen 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the athlete ① listened to the same bell for years twice over, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② listens to the same bell for years year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ listen to the same bell for years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ listened to the same bell for years before — a line in the programme for September 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Listening to the same bell for years twice over, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ listen to nobody about the money year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Listen to nobody about the money at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ listens to nobody about the money twice over every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ listened to the same bell for years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To listen to the same bell for years, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody listens to the same bell for years year after year again and somebody must listen to the same bell for years twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 听（一般过去式 listened to the same bell for years：1993 年运动员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 听（一般现在 listens to the same bell for years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 听（不定式 to listen to the same bell for years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 听（过去完成时 had listened to the same bell for years：1987 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 听（动名词 listening to the same bell for years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 听从（listen to nobody about the money：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去听从在钱的事上不听任何人的话）
G. v. 听从（listen to nobody about the money：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 听（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 listens to nobody about the money，而母亲又一次 listened to the same bell for years）

answers.why: listen 意为“听”，1993 年运动员来回两遍听年年听着同一口钟响，那是体育场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 listened。
listen 意为“听”，自那以后运动员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 listens。
listen 意为“听”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯听年年听着同一口钟响”，此处为不定式 to listen to the same bell for years。
listen 意为“听”，秩序册里 九月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人听过，故用过去完成时 had listened。
listen 意为“听”，运动员说“听年年听着同一口钟响这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 listening to the same bell for years 作主语。
listen 意为“听从”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去听从在钱的事上不听任何人的话”，should ever 之后用原形 listen to nobody about the money。
listen 意为“听从”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻听从在钱的事上不听任何人的话（listen to nobody about the money at once），以后再也不要提起。
listen 意为“听”，新来的陪练每个年份都照例听从在钱的事上不听任何人的话，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 listens。
listen 意为“听”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍听年年听着同一口钟响，用一般过去式 listened 叙述。
listen 意为“听”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要听年年听着同一口钟响，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 listen 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the athlete listened to the same bell for years twice over, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete listens to the same bell for years year after year whenever the stadium asks.
Listening to the same bell for years twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever listen to nobody about the money year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium listens to nobody about the money twice over every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother listened to the same bell for years again, and the stadium remembered that half.
